title: Secretary Rubio’s Call with Foreign Minister Gerapetritis
author: Marco Rubio, Secretary of State
summary:
Marco Rubio, Secretary of State

Secretary Rubio’s Call with Foreign Minister Gerapetritis

Readout

August 12, 2026

The below is attributable to Spokesperson Tommy Pigott:

Secretary of State Marco Rubio spoke with Greek Foreign Minister Giorgios Gerapetritis today regarding the importance of U.S.-Greece cooperation in the Eastern Mediterranean.  Secretary Rubio thanked Greece for its role as a stalwart NATO ally and reaffirmed the continued strength of the United States-Greece bilateral relationship in defense, energy, law enforcement, technology, and enduring connections between our people.
